_comment: The browser tools for Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks. AutolaunchWeb.ToolManifest adds them to tool_manifest.json only while the site offers them (AUTOLAUNCH_EXPOSURE=true). A public tool's `request` is the HTTP request it makes: `path` with each {field} filled from its input, and `body` the input fields it posts.

tools.name: autolaunch_after_hour_stocks_list
tools.title: List Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks weeks
tools.description: List Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks on Base at the latest block: this week and the last eight weeks that opened, newest first. Each week splits one Base stock token for one trading week into an After-hours token (the stock's moves from each close to the next open) and a Market-hours token (its moves from each open to the close). A week opens with its first deposit; until then it is listed with the series address it will open at and the terms it would open with. Each week comes with its number, whether it is this week and whether it has opened, its stock and two tokens (address, symbol, decimals), each token's ledger value in WAD dollars per stock token and its pool quote in micro-USDC, the status (unopened, pending, active or ended) and why it ended, the last price, how many prices are applied and waiting, the deposit cap and the amount deposited in raw stock units, the schedule of opens and closes (Unix seconds, each applying an hour later), whether the price feed can be read, and the terms' fingerprint and address. The answer also names the factory, the current week and whether opening new weeks is paused. Reads only; needs no sign-in.

tools.name: autolaunch_after_hour_stocks_week
tools.title: Read an Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks week
tools.description: Read one week of Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks on Base at the latest block, in the same shape as each week of autolaunch_after_hour_stocks_list, with every price its series has applied: the time, the price and both ledger values (WAD dollars per stock token) and the Chainlink round it came from. Reads only; needs no sign-in.

week.description: The week number, as autolaunch_after_hour_stocks_list gives it: this week, or one of the weeks that has opened.

tools.name: autolaunch_my_after_hour_stocks
tools.title: Read my Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks holding
tools.description: Read my person's holding for one week of Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks on Base, for their signed-in wallet, at the latest block: their After-hours, Market-hours, stock and USDC balances and the stock they let the factory take for a deposit, in raw token units, and what they can redeem now (whole pairs before the week ends, every token after it) with the raw stock it pays. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

week.description: The week number, as autolaunch_after_hour_stocks_list gives it: this week, or one of the weeks that has opened.

tools.name: autolaunch_after_hour_stocks_prepare
tools.title: Prepare an Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks step
tools.description: Prepare the wallet steps for one Isolated Exposure to After-hours Stocks action on one week on Base: buy (leg and amount in USDC micro-units: an exact USDC approval to the Aerodrome router, then a swap for that token through its pool, taking at least the pool's quote less 2%), sell (leg and amount in raw token units: an exact approval of the token, then a swap for USDC), deposit (amount in raw stock units, this week only: an exact stock approval to the factory, then the factory's deposit, which opens the week on its first deposit and gives this many of each token), redeem (overnight and session: return tokens for the stock; equal amounts at any time, any mix once the week has ended) or settle (apply every price that is due; open to anyone, and it never fails for being early). The steps are for one of my person's own wallets: signer when given, otherwise the wallet they signed in with; any other wallet is refused. The site only prepares: the wallet's own key signs and sends each step in turn (to, data, value on chain), and money moves only then. approved says whether the allowance already covers the action; blocked names, in code and words, a reason the chain's current state makes the action certain to fail, and the steps are still returned. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

week.description: The week number, as autolaunch_after_hour_stocks_list gives it: this week, or one of the weeks that has opened.

leg.description: For buy and sell: overnight for the After-hours token, session for the Market-hours token.

amount.description: For buy: USDC micro-units to spend. For sell: raw token units to sell. For deposit: raw stock units to deposit; the wallet receives this many of each token.

overnight.description: For redeem: raw After-hours units to return. Before the week ends it must equal session.

session.description: For redeem: raw Market-hours units to return. Before the week ends it must equal overnight.

signer.description: One of my person's own wallet addresses, 0x and 40 hex digits. Omit it to use the wallet they signed in with.
